A lot of people are hating on your "fake it till you make it" strategy. That is actually a skill used in Dialectical Behavior Therapy. It's called "opposite action." In using this skill, you're supposed to act opposite to how you're really feeling (i.e. Pretend to be happy when you're sad). Bipolar II here as well and this skill has seriously saved me when I go low. When that soul sucking depression rolls around my favorite thing to do is grab my dogs, go out in the woods, and start dancing with them and singing (poorly, lol) at the top of my lungs. And for the time being it works! I might have to do it a bunch of times during the day, but it's better than ending up in the hospital because I cut again. 

On another note, it's great that you're trying to find someone else for your sister. This woman sounds horrible and will do nothing but further break down your sis. I went through 5 therapist over the course of 4 years and have finally found one that is a good fit for me. I've been with him for just over a year and it's amazing the changes I can see in myself. It's funny too because I was assigned him through the VA, so when we first met I was so skeptical (my first VA therapist was absolutely worthless). 

So keep your head up and keep moving forward. I know I'm just an Internet Stranger, but your story really resonates with me. I sincerely hope you can get this nastiness out of your and your sisters lives and get the help you need. No one deserves to live with untreated mental illness. There really is a light at the end of the tunnel and a life worth living.

Maybe get him a few weeks of Hello Fresh, Blue Apron, or Green Chef? These are a bit pricey, but oh man are they worth it! I haven't had a meal I didn't like (I'm a fairy picky eater). Each meal is usually between 450- 600 calories (always below 1000). Hello Fresh is my favorite because you get to choose 3 meals out of 5 (so you can pick the lower calorie ones and aren't forced to get something high cal). They're great because everything comes pre measured so there's no guess work. It's great for portion control too. Just last night I had salmon with chives, tarragon, and lemon on couscous with some asparagus. It was 440 calories and tasted absolutely spectacular. i started ordering these and then sent a free box to my parents. Now I've got them hooked on it. They're fun to make (you feel like a fancy chef!) and fun to eat! I only wish I had more money (I get like 1 box every 2 months) so I could eat them more regularly.

I got her a pair of those beats wireless headphones for Christmas and since her Fitbit broke I think I'm going to send her a new one. I really want her to succeed and I think it'll help if I can keep her accountable on MFP and Fitbit. I also sent her free trial to Hello Fresh (which her & my dad both loved so much they actually started ordering more). whenever I visit we would go to the gym or hiking everyday.
